display_name: Inositol for Polycystic Ovary Syndrome: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis to Inform the 2023 Update of the International Evidence-based PCOS Guidelines
document_title: Inositol for Polycystic Ovary Syndrome: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis to Inform the 2023 Update of the International Evidence-based PCOS Guidelines
organization_name: Teede et al.; Journal of Clinical Endocrinology & Metabolism
what_it_supports: PCOS-specific metabolic, hormonal and reproductive outcomes
limitations: Do not generalize to people without PCOS.
No specific formulation or dose can be recommended from this evidence.
Pregnancy outcomes require separate evidence and assessment.
